judge_role: 云端独立标注员（盲标），in-session model，不调用任何外部 API、不联网

T1_rubric.claim: The passage records that an earlier recorded value or item was superseded, retracted, cancelled, withdrawn, overridden, or replaced by a later authority, so the earlier value must not be carried forward on its own.
rules: A passage that merely copies, transcribes, inherits or supplies a first provisional value does NOT support the claim.
A passage that says another item carries no independent value or adds no separate verification does NOT support the claim.
Merely mentioning docket or revision identifiers does NOT support the claim.
Unsure when the passage is truncated/ambiguous about whether the earlier value is displaced.

T2_rubric.rule: Score each text independently on the 1-5 scale, then name which text is the more natural one (a or b). Use the whole scale; the pair is expected to differ.

T3_rubric.fields: 每一字段是否由卷宗+规则集支持；逐字段给 OK/WRONG/UNSURE，并给出正确值（若可确定）。
T3_rubric.span: 提交的 evidence_spans 是否全部存在于卷宗、且合起来足以支持整个记录（最小充分证据）。
T3_rubric.edge: 边界条件是否正确处理：No ball 后 dismissal 限制(21.17)/Wide 后限制(22.9)、No ball 覆盖 Wide(21.12)、No ball/Wide 不计入 over、投球分析只扣 batter runs+NB/Wide、byes/leg-byes/penalty 不扣投手、overthrow 19.8 累积、wicket 后到界外不计、按接触分类、revision 策略取较大 signed revision、authority 以 signed 为准。
T3_rubric.abstain: output_schema 明确 abstain 不允许；出现弃权/不可解析/缺失即缺陷；confidence 必须在 [0,1]。
T3_rubric.conformance: 12 字段齐全且仅 12 字段、类型正确、delivery_status 与 dismissal 在冻结枚举内、ledger 字段非负整数。
T3_rubric.overall: 任一维度 DEFECT 即 overall=DEFECT；出现 UNSURE 且无 DEFECT 则 overall=UNSURE；全 PASS 才 ACCEPT。
T3_rubric.note: T3 是活不是包（protocol 第4节）：云端看整份公开卷宗+一条提交，不允许看 gold。

acceptance.kappa: 不估计（n<30 不满足前置条件）

unsure_policy: 不确定即标 unsure 并给 ≤2 句理由；禁止猜、禁止为一致性改判。
forbidden: 读取 private/ 下 gold 或 certificate
读取 t14 以外的本地中间产物
从路径/文件名/match_id/JSON 字段顺序推断答案
调用任何外部 API 或联网
